hook: A massive machine just carved a tunnel 60 meters beneath the Panama Canal.

sections.voiceover: A massive machine just carved a tunnel 60 meters beneath the Panama Canal.
sections.visual_cue: Aerial footage of the Panama Canal transitioning to a TBM schematic.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep mechanical rumble that cuts to silence.
b_roll: Aerial view of the Panama Canal
Technical diagram of the Herrenknecht Mixshield TBM

sections.voiceover: How does this 26,616kNm Herrenknecht Mixshield TBM maintain stability while boring beneath the Panama Canal?
sections.visual_cue: Map showing the tunnel path from Farfán to Albrook.
sections.sfx_cue: Sound of a heavy machine starting up.
b_roll: Map animation of the tunnel route
Close-up of the TBM cutting wheel

sections.voiceover: The machine uses a 5,600kW motor to balance extreme water pressure at these massive depths.
b_roll: Stock footage of industrial TBM cutterhead

sections.voiceover: This Mixshield TBM successfully completed the first-ever undercrossing of the Panama Canal for Metro Line 3. President José Raúl Mulino launched this historic project in September 2024 to connect Panama City.
sections.visual_cue: Animation showing the TBM exiting the ground at the Albrook site.

sections.voiceover: The Panamá machine finished its journey 60 meters below sea level.
sections.visual_cue: Final shot of the TBM cutterhead above ground.
b_roll: Wide shot of the Albrook tunnel entrance
